answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents register identity via zero-knowledge proofs validating cryptographic attestation chains from trusted enclaves. Each peer staking fee scales superlinearly: a lone sparrow agent pays negligible bond, but a malicious swarm faces exponential capital exhaustion. A verifiable beacon, tracking network vitality like a lantern guiding transactions or a comet flashing across consensus, invalidates uncollateralized clones.
